lastReleaseMessage: Bar-raise burn-down: guard consolidation, receipt archiving, status-writer fix, version bump to v1.4.0

barRaise.topFinding: Every medium and high finding carried into this run is closed in code and verified: the save failure now reports instead of printing a silent success, the prune has a real test, the cost readout says it is an estimate, the readiness check warns on an old runtime, and an unmatched stream line renders rather than vanishing. The proof-of-life receipt the previous run asked for exists. What it proves is thin: one connectivity check, produced to close that finding, against thirteen locked decisions and eight versioned burn-downs on a tool that reached version one on 2026-06-23. Receipts dated 2026-06-18 are also still on disk past a ninety-day retention the code claims to enforce.

actions.title: Require a real prompt run against a real target repository before accepting further hardening work here, or decide to throttle this project's review cadence given its usage level.
Correct the comment to name the ninety-day prune, and confirm directly that the prune reaches eligible files in the live receipts directory and not only in the test scratch directory.

REDACTED: this text named a weakness and the file it lives in, which together are an address. Severity and project are kept; the location is in the project's own report under X:\PortfolioOps.
the run console caps retained spans at 500 and coalesces the scroll read and write into one animation-frame callback instead of one per line. Commit 9288589.

POST /run and the POST /new-project scaffold share an in-flight session counter, surfaced on GET /healthz for the loopback caller, and each carries a wall-clock kill timer, thirty minutes for a run and twenty for a scaffold. Commit 7dde37f. The timeout itself is not exercised by a unit test because the wall clock is the trigger; the counter and the kill path are.

presets.json moves the release and changelog presets off the expensive model to the mid-tier one, and leaves the audit and bar-raise presets on the expensive one where the reasoning depth is the point. Commit f6add89; the file was read back after the atomic write and the presets shape test still passes.

docs/DESIGN.md records D-013, the verified-compatible command-line-tool range of 2.0.0 up to but not including 3.0.0, confirmed live at 2.1.156, and scripts/check-readiness.ps1 warns rather than fails when the installed major version falls outside it. Commits e2ef955 and 7dde37f; the readiness script was run and prints the new range line as OK.

renderQueue in public/index.html routes the project, priority and added fields through the existing escape helper instead of putting them straight into innerHTML. Commit 9288589, syntax checked with node --check on the extracted script.

a new GET /models route serves the model list and the default, and public/index.html fetches it at boot instead of carrying its own hardcoded array. Commits 7dde37f and 9288589, with a new route test. Verified 2026-09-04 by running node --test test/server.test.mjs in X:/YesAndAgents: 72 of 72 pass. All commits pushed, main matches origin/main.
